name: dumbbell lying close grip parallel row on rack
description: A chest-supported row lying on a rack with a neutral grip, working the lats and mid back.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench or rack with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
